svg.title: shotsheet brand: a clip becomes a shootable sheet
svg.desc: shotsheet wordmark and advantage: every shot carries its source timecode. A vertical source clip connects to a shot sheet with per-shot tc_in and to a plaintext Jianying draft timeline.
